core_obligations: RΓ(X, E^∧) = R lim RΓ(X, E_n) by the commutation of RΓ with R lim, viewing the structure map as a morphism to a point (proof lines 10019-10022).

Identify RΓ(X, E_n) = RΓ(X, E) ⊗_A^L (A →^{f^n} A); the source summarizes this as details omitted, which is the one-line tensor-triangle computation E_n = E ⊗^L (O_X →^f^n O_X) (proof lines 10023-10027).

Conclude RΓ(X,E^∧) is the derived f-adic completion of RΓ(X,E) and obtain the displayed commutative diagram with the f-torsion from More on Algebra, Lemma compare-completion-derived-completion (proof lines 10028-10031).
